name: Gaon Ki Beti Yojana
department: Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: INR 500 per month for 10 months, i.e. INR 5,000 per year (the district page states INR 750 per month / INR 7,500 per year for technical and medical courses).

name: Awas Sahayata Yojana (rent assistance for SC/ST college students)
department: Tribal Affairs Department and Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: Rent assistance for 12 months, paid in two six-monthly instalments (July and January): INR 2,000 per month in Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur and Ujjain; INR 1,250 per month at other district headquarters; INR 1,000 per month at tehsil / block headquarters (rate depends on where the student rents, rule 4(2), 4(4)).

name: Pratibhashali Vidyarthi Protsahan Yojana (laptop incentive)
department: School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: INR 25,000 one time, transferred by DBT to the student's bank account to buy a laptop.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
department: Technical Education, Skill Development and Employment Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: Admission fee and the actual tuition fee fixed by the fee regulatory committee / MP private university regulatory commission / Government (mess fee and caution money excluded), every year until the course ends. Private engineering colleges: up to INR 1.5 lakh or the actual fee, whichever is less. The amount depends on the course and institution.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
department: Revenue Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: INR 6,000 per year in three equal instalments (April-July, August-November, December-March), paid by the State in addition to the INR 6,000 PM-KISAN benefit.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India

benefit.description: Cashless and paperless hospitalisation cover of up to INR 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled hospitals. Senior citizens aged 70+ in already covered families get an additional top-up of up to INR 5 lakh per year for themselves.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

benefit.description: INR 6,000 per year per farmer family, paid by DBT in three instalments of INR 2,000 every four months.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Department of Rural Development, Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India

benefit.description: Unit assistance of INR 1.20 lakh (plain areas, the default for Madhya Pradesh; INR 1.30 lakh in difficult / IAP areas) to build a pucca house of at least 25 sq m, plus 90/95 person-days of MGNREGS wages and INR 12,000 for a toilet through SBM(G)/MGNREGS.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students (Madhya Pradesh)
department: Backward Classes and Minority Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh

benefit.description: Maintenance allowance plus reimbursement of compulsory fees, paid by e-payment to the student's bank account; the amount depends on family income, institution, course group, course fee and fee caps.
